subject: Packaging workshop: tier selection, legacy feature swap, and migration timing
messages:
From: Emma Hargreaves <emma@harlow.ai>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@harlow.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging questions and a short workshop

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. We have three items blocking our internal decision:

1) Tier selection: we're trying to decide between Compact (lower-cost, quantized) vs Full (higher throughput, KV cache for multi-turn). Typical monthly token volume today ~1.2B tokens.
2) Legacy features: we have an existing embedding/semantic search pipeline that depends on model-v1 embeddings; can we keep that enabled if we move to Compact?
3) Migration timing and one-off credits/discounts for a pilot period (3 months).

Can we set up a short workshop next week to map the usage profile and see which plan fits? I've attached a quick write-up of our current traffic and feature needs.

Attachments: harlow-packaging-ask.docx (docx)

Cheers,
Emma
Head of AI Platforms
Harlow
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Hargreaves <emma@harlow.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@harlow.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging questions and a short workshop

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the write-up, very helpful.

Quick answers up-front:
- Compact can support your embedding pipeline, but we recommend keeping a small Full pool for latency-sensitive multi-turns (helps with prefix/KV cache).
- We can do a 3-month pilot with a temporary blended price and a one-time feature unlock for legacy embedding compatibility.

Proposed next steps:
- 60-minute workshop: usage breakout (30m) + recommendation + rollout plan (30m) — propose Tue 6/16 10am PT or Wed 6/17 2pm PT.
- I'll bring a short decision matrix (Compact vs Full) and two runway pricing scenarios (metered vs reserved burst).
- Ben, can you prepare the pilot pricing sheet and a suggested concession cadence?
- Lauren, we may need a one-time commercial approval for a migration credit — can you flag if this looks like a standard pilot concession?

I've attached a short proposal (Compact vs Full).
Attachments: redwood-proposal-compact-vs-full.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Hargreaves <emma@harlow.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.p@harlow.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging questions and a short workshop

Looping in a couple of numbers before the workshop.

- Baseline pilot pricing idea: 40% off list for the first 3 months on metered tokens, with a capped max monthly spend (cap to be agreed). After pilot, move to a tiered reserved commit if they want predictable throughput.
- Feature unlock: one-time compatibility flag for legacy embeddings + an allocation of prefix cache (50M tokens) to mitigate cold-starts for existing sessions.

Questions for Lauren:
- Is 40% standard for a pilot at this stage? Any limits on committing to a 3-month concession tied to onboarding milestones?

Ben
Senior Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks team — reviewed. A few decisions from the commercial side:

- Approve a one-time 35% pilot discount (Ben, please reflect 35% in the quote) — lower than Ben proposed but acceptable with clear milestone gating.
- Approve the one-time legacy-embedding compatibility unlock for the pilot. This is not a permanent entitlement; we'll record it as a migration assistance line item in the SOW.
- Cap proposal: pass on the capped-spend commitment for now; instead include a soft cap recommendation in the pilot runbook and revisit at pilot end.

Please update the proposal and the quote and share back with Emma/Samir before the workshop. I'll sign off on the final DocuSign once the quote reflects 35% and a short SOW section about the temporary feature unlock.
